Q: Thank you for agreeing to give a recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather not give my full name on a recording, but you can note that I'm the driver of the vehicle involved.
Q: That's fine. Can you describe where the collision happened?
A: It was in a shopping center parking lot in Katy, Texas. I was pulling out of a space near the main entrance when
the other car hit my rear driver's side.
Q: Were you moving or stopped when the impact occurred?
A: I had just started rolling backward out of the space. I'd checked my mirrors, but I didn't see the other vehicle
coming down the aisle.
Q: How fast would you estimate you were going?
A: Maybe two or three miles an hour. It was a very slow parking lot speed.
Q: Did you exchange information with the other driver?
A: Yes, we swapped insurance cards and phone numbers. He said he was looking at his phone for a second.
Q: Were you hurt at the scene?
A: Not right away. I felt fine standing there, but by the next morning my neck was stiff and my lower back was sore,
mostly on the left side.
Q: Have you sought medical treatment since the collision?
A: Yes, I saw my family doctor and then a physical therapist. They diagnosed a neck and back strain and I've been
doing exercises a few times a week.
Q: Are you still experiencing symptoms today?
A: Yes, my neck still hurts when I turn my head to the right, and I have trouble sitting for long periods. Some days are
better than others.
Q: Is tehre anything else you'd like to add to your statement?
A: Only that I'm cooperating fully and I want this handled properly. Thank you for your time.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
</page>

  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
